description: Accessibilité des arrêts de bus RATP is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Régie autonome des transports parisiens (RATP). This file contains a list of the stop points of RATP buses, specifying which ones are accessible, as well as details of their accessibility equipment. Coverage: Régie autonome des transports parisiens (RATP). The portal shows the English title as "Accessibility of RATP bus stops" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Régie autonome des transports parisiens (RATP). Its keywords include accessibilite. The listing shows 4 download or service links in XLS, PDF. The listing shows 2016-01-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
